key_concepts: The mole is the SI unit for amount of substance
One mole contains Avogadro's number of particles, 6.022 x 10^23
One mole of an element contains 6.022 x 10^23 atoms
One mole of a compound contains 6.022 x 10^23 molecules
Formula mass is the sum of atomic masses in an ionic formula unit
Molecular mass is the sum of atomic masses in a molecule
Molar mass is the mass of one mole expressed in g/mol
Mass and moles are interconverted using molar mass
Number of particles and moles are interconverted using Avogadro's number
Balanced equation coefficients give mole ratios for stoichiometric conversions
